LightningComponentBundle.description: Invisible bridge between Salesforce (quick actions, Flows, records) and the Contact Center workspace Embed SDK and host API. Place it next to the Contact Center Workspace container.

property.name: instanceId
property.label: Host API Instance ID
property.description: Matches the Host API Instance ID on the Contact Center Workspace container.

property.name: placement
property.label: Placement
property.description: utility: workspace in the utility bar. page: workspace on a record or app page.

property.name: autoScreenPop
property.label: Open the caller's contact
property.description: Opens the matched contact once when a conversation is accepted. On a record page that already shows the contact, refreshes it instead.
